invariants.claim: A successful call enters only from Active or Drawing after its branch-specific sponsor/time predicate passes.
At the draw-request deadline requestDraw rejects while the sold-Active refund path becomes available.
At the callback deadline fulfillRandomWords ignores the callback while the Drawing refund path becomes available.
Every successful call sets unsettledPot to zero, assigns its prior value to remainingRefundLiability, sets Refunding, and emits that same liability.
The sponsor's early authority exists only for Active with zero totalEntries; sponsorRecipient has no authority in this function.
